page.overview:
Who is 3MO?

3MO is a MO robot "owned" by Princess Bubblegum — part of Adventure Time.

They are very similar in shape to BMO, but have a different face location and different buttons. They are also of a brown color instead of blue/green.

In Adventure Time, 3MO sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
